_readme: Episode details noted by hand from the audio, for things the official guides don't have. Key: the episode id (from its URL, /episodes/<id>/). Fields, all optional: "hero", the listener given the hero shout-out; "reviews", each a film's full title (and release year for premiums, as on TMDB) with each host's score written as said: "3.5/4", "6/5", or with the light/heavy the hosts sometimes add, "light 4". A bare number is out of 5 unless another host's rating names the scale. build-data adds the reviews, or fills in the ratings of a review the guides already list.
